edits:
Use case: identity-preserve.
Asset type: a dedicated four-frame one-handed sword attack animation atlas for native Godot, actual transparent background.
Input image is the EDIT TARGET, not a concept to slice. Keep the same adult KA woman knight, amber eyes, auburn high ponytail, ivory steel armor with gold trim, crimson cape, star brooch and SAME one-handed straight longsword. Keep the four different articulated body/arm/leg poses. Change ONLY placement and scale so every pose, its COMPLETE sword and cape fit safely inside its own cell.
Composition: exact 2 by 2 equal cells. Frame 0 upper left ready guard, frame 1 upper right overhead windup, frame 2 lower left forward horizontal slash, frame 3 lower right low recovery. RECOMPOSE all four at a smaller identical body scale, about 65% of the previous size. Full silhouette INCLUDING THE LONG SWORD may occupy at most 75% of each half-canvas width and 75% of its height. Leave at least 12% clear empty space from EVERY cell edge, especially the central vertical and horizontal seams. The bottom-left long horizontal blade must END well BEFORE the central seam, never touch the bottom-right character. Same body height in all cells; don't shorten sword to make it fit, scale the WHOLE actor uniformly smaller. Boots share local baseline in all cells.
Style: detailed tactical RPG pixel-art clusters with clean opaque subject interiors, crisp edges. Preserve anatomy, two hands, one holds sword, other balances. No new weapons/shields. No blur, particles, motion swoosh, shadows, floor, text, borders or checkerboard. Truly transparent alpha.

Use case: background-extraction. EDIT TARGET: the attached four-frame knight sword atlas. Remove ALL the reddish, grey and black background haze, all light halos and shadows. Background must be truly alpha zero everywhere outside the four bodies and swords. Subject interiors fully opaque.
Also correct the frame separation: canvas tall portrait 1280 by 1600, an exact 2x2 equal grid. Upper two actors stay strictly inside upper left and upper right cells. Lower two strictly inside lower cells. Each FULL actor including the longest extended sword and cape fits in 80% of its cell width and 80% cell height, leave 10% margin on every edge, no crossing center seams. Uniform body scale across the four poses, reduce whole actors as needed, never crop or shorten the sword. Each actor's boots baseline at 88% of its OWN cell height. No floor or background, no glows, no labels or lines. Preserve face, adult body, armor and four poses, two arms and hands, complete longswords. Crisp detailed pixel art.

Edit this dedicated animation sheet only for spacing. Shrink EACH complete character AND her complete sword to 55 percent of its current size. Place the four smaller sprites in a perfectly regular 2 by 2 grid on a tall transparent canvas. Huge transparent empty cross-shaped gutter, at least 200 pixels wide, must separate the four sprites. Preserve all four poses, identity, full longsword length, full boots and cape, clear separate two hands. Each sprite completely separate, no touching, no overlap, no clipping. Same body scale across frames. No background glow, no floor, no text.
